name: Translating the Journal
summary: Jarkal offers to translate the journal if you let him borrow the necklace. He expects the bargain to benefit you both while Droffers and Son Salvage get what they want.

sections.title: A Bargain
sections.body: Jarkal wants to borrow the necklace in exchange for translating the journal. He believes you and he will each gain what you seek, while Droffers and Son Salvage will also think they have gained their wishes.

faq.answer: Jarkal asks to borrow the necklace and offers to translate the journal in exchange.
You let Jarkal borrow the necklace, and he translates the journal for you.

faq.q: Who is Droffers and Son Salvage?
faq.answer: Droffers and Son Salvage are named in Jarkal's description of the bargain; he says they will think they are getting what they want.

faq.q: What does Jarkal think will happen?
faq.answer: Jarkal thinks you and he will each get what you want, and Droffers and Son Salvage will think the same.
